content: IBM OpenPages Simplify how you manage risk and regulatory compliance with a unified GRC platform Book live demo OVERVIEW Smarter GRC with AI, safer AI with GRC IBM OpenPages is a scalable, AI-powered GRC platform that helps organizations manage risk, compliance, and audit functions in one integrated solution. Available on any cloud or on-premises, OpenPages offers a modular and integrated approach to Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), allowing organizations to deploy only the components they need-each tailored to specific risk and compliance domains.
